title: Believing Youth founded
summary: A Zaydi revivalist youth network forms in Saada. The Houthi movement grows out of it.

title: First Saada war
summary: Government forces move against Hussein Badr al-Din al-Houthi and his followers.

title: Hussein al-Houthi killed
summary: The movement's founder dies in fighting. Leadership later passes to his brother Abdulmalik.

title: Ceasefire ends sixth war
summary: Six rounds of war since 2004 end in a ceasefire, without a settlement.

title: Saleh signs GCC initiative
summary: After months of protest, Saleh agrees to hand power to his deputy, Abd Rabbuh Mansur Hadi.

title: Dammaj evacuated
summary: Salafi students and families leave the Dar al-Hadith institute in Saada after siege and fighting.

title: Amran falls
summary: The 310th Armoured Brigade is overrun. Its commander is killed.

title: Houthis take Sanaa
summary: The Peace and National Partnership Agreement is signed the same evening.

title: UN sanctions Saleh and two Houthi commanders
summary: Designations under Security Council resolution 2140.

title: Hadi resigns
summary: Follows the Houthi seizure of the presidential palace.

title: Coalition intervention begins
summary: A Saudi-led coalition launches airstrikes in support of Hadi's government.

title: Resolution 2216
summary: The Security Council demands Houthi withdrawal and imposes an arms embargo on the movement's leaders.

title: Wedding strike near Mokha
summary: Airstrikes hit a wedding gathering. The UN reported more than 130 killed.

title: Funeral hall strike, Sanaa
summary: Strikes on a crowded funeral hall kill more than 100 people, according to the UN.

title: Saleh killed
summary: The Houthis kill their former ally days after he breaks with them.

title: School bus strike, Dahyan
summary: An airstrike on a bus in Saada governorate kills dozens, most of them children.

title: Stockholm Agreement
summary: UN-brokered deal on Hodeidah, prisoner exchange and Taiz.

title: Abqaiq and Khurais attack
summary: The Houthis claim strikes on Saudi oil facilities. The US and others attribute them to Iran.

title: Attack on Abu Dhabi
summary: Houthi drones and missiles hit the UAE capital. Three people are killed.

title: Nationwide truce
summary: A UN-brokered truce begins. Fighting falls sharply after it expires in October.

title: Galaxy Leader seized
summary: The start of a campaign against commercial shipping in the Red Sea.

title: US and UK strikes begin
summary: Strikes target Houthi military sites in response to the shipping attacks.

title: UN and NGO staff detained
summary: The Houthis detain staff of UN agencies and aid groups. Further detentions follow.

title: US–Houthi ceasefire
summary: An Oman-brokered understanding halts US strikes and Houthi attacks on US ships.

title: Houthi prime minister killed
summary: An Israeli strike in Sanaa kills Ahmed al-Rahawi and several ministers.
